name: Creamy coriander soya chunks with paneer-cashew gravy
creator: Ralston D'Souza
description: High-protein soya chunks fried crisp, then simmered in a creamy blended gravy of low-fat paneer and cashews with coriander, curry leaves and pepper. One filling single-serve portion.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp for boiling + 1/2 tsp in gravy

steps: Boil water with a teaspoon of salt, add the soya chunks and cook for 6 to 7 minutes.
Squeeze out most of the water, but leave the chunks slightly moist.
Toss the chunks with corn flour, coriander powder and Kashmiri chilli powder until coated.
Heat half the ghee in a pan on medium heat and fry the coated chunks for 5 to 7 minutes until lightly crisp.
Add the rest of the ghee, then the onion, ginger, garlic, green chillies and curry leaves. Cook for about 5 minutes.
Blend the low-fat paneer with soaked cashews and 200 ml water until smooth. Add more water for a thinner gravy.
Pour the paneer-cashew mixture into the pan, add half a teaspoon of salt and the black pepper, and mix well.
Add chopped coriander and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until creamy. Serve hot.

name: Paneer kati rolls with mint chutney
creator: Ralston D'Souza
description: Yogurt-spiced low-fat paneer cooked with onion and bell pepper, rolled in a chapati with fresh mint-coriander chutney and lime. Makes 4 rolls, one chapati each.

ingredients.name: Red chilli powder
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp in marinade + 1 tsp in chutney

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp marinade + 1/4 tsp chutney + 1 tsp pan

ingredients.name: Coriander leaves
ingredients.amount: a handful for chutney + fresh for topping

ingredients.name: Lime juice
ingredients.amount: 1/2 lime (10 ml) + a squeeze to serve

steps: Mix yogurt with ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, garam masala, turmeric, kasuri methi and 1 tsp salt. Coat the paneer well and set aside.
Blend coriander, mint, cumin seeds, chilli powder, garlic, ginger, lime juice, a pinch of salt and 80 ml water until smooth.
Heat ghee in a pan on medium-high. Cook the sliced onion and bell pepper with 1 tsp salt for 3 to 4 minutes until the onion turns translucent.
Add the marinated paneer and cook another 3 to 4 minutes. Set aside.
Warm the chapatis as per the pack instructions.
Spread mint chutney on each chapati, add the paneer mix, fresh coriander and a squeeze of lime. Roll tightly and serve.

name: Creamy paneer sandwich with veggies
creator: See source link
description: Toasted multigrain sandwich filled with a blended low-fat paneer and Greek yogurt spread, mixed with grated carrot, cucumber, onion and coriander. Makes 2 sandwiches.
steps: Blend the paneer, garlic, Greek yogurt, chilli flakes, dried red chillies, lime juice and salt until smooth and creamy.
In a bowl, mix chopped onion, grated carrot, grated cucumber and coriander. Stir in the paneer sauce to make the filling.
Spread half the filling on one slice of multigrain bread and close with a second slice. Repeat for the second sandwich.
Toast the sandwiches in a pan with butter until golden and crisp on both sides.

name: Creamy chicken and egg salad
creator: See source link
description: Shredded boiled chicken breast tossed with chopped tomato and onion in a creamy sauce of blended boiled egg, soft garlic, Kashmiri chilli and yogurt. High protein, one serving.
steps: Boil the eggs, chicken breast and garlic cloves together in a pot of water. The eggs need 10 minutes and the chicken must be cooked all the way through.
Take out the garlic once soft, peel the eggs, and set the chicken aside to cool, then shred it.
Blend the boiled eggs, garlic, dried Kashmiri chillies and yogurt into a smooth, creamy sauce.
In a bowl, combine the shredded chicken, chopped tomato and onion, the creamy sauce, salt and oregano. Mix well and serve.

name: One-pan creamy paneer white sauce pasta
creator: See source link
description: Pasta simmered with onion and tomato until it absorbs the water, then finished in a blended sauce of low-fat paneer, milk, garlic and red chilli. Serves 2.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: 1/2 tsp in pasta + 1/4 tsp in sauce

steps: Put the raw pasta, chopped onion and tomato, 300 ml water and half a teaspoon of salt in a pan. Cover with the lid slightly open and boil on medium heat for about 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, blend the low-fat paneer, garlic, red chilli, a quarter teaspoon of salt and the milk until smooth.
When the pasta has soaked up most of the water, pour in the sauce and cook on low heat for 5 to 10 minutes.
Sprinkle oregano on top and serve hot.

name: Creamy tomato-cashew noodles with air-fried chicken
creator: See source link
description: Noodles cooked with onion, capsicum, chilli and garlic, finished in a blended tomato-cashew sauce and topped with air-fried chicken thigh pieces. One high-protein serving.
steps: Air fry the chicken thigh pieces until cooked through and set them aside.

In a pan, put the raw noodles, onion, capsicum, chopped green chilli, garlic, tomato, dried red chillies and 300 ml water. Cover and cook about 10 minutes until the noodles are soft, adding a little water if it gets too dry.
Take out the tomato and dried chillies and blend them with the cashews and about a cup of the noodle water into a sauce. Drain any extra water left in the pan.
Pour the sauce back into the pan, add the air-fried chicken and cook on low heat for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

name: High-protein peri peri paneer sandwich
creator: See source link
description: Peri peri spiced high-protein paneer, pan-crisped with sesame, layered with a Schezwan-yogurt spread, cheese, cucumber, beetroot and tomato in a toasted protein bread sandwich. One serving.
steps: Coat the paneer evenly with peri peri masala.
Lightly spray a pan with oil, sprinkle in the sesame seeds and shallow-fry the paneer on both sides until slightly crisp and golden.
Mix the Schezwan chutney and Greek yogurt until smooth.
Spread the sauce on one bread slice, then layer the peri peri paneer, cheese slice, cucumber, beetroot and tomato. Sprinkle black pepper on top.
Close with the second slice and toast until crisp. Serve hot.

name: High-protein yogurt salad dressing
creator: See source link
description: Quick no-cook dressing of whisked high-protein yogurt with soy sauce, vinegar, black pepper, oregano and optional garlic and coriander. Creamy and tangy for salads.
steps: Whisk the yogurt in a bowl until smooth.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, salt, black pepper and oregano.
Stir in the garlic and coriander if using.
Whisk until creamy and well mixed, then taste and adjust the salt or tanginess.

name: Creamy paneer mushroom sauté
creator: See source link
description: Golden onions and garlic with button mushrooms, simmered in a blended low-fat paneer sauce with pepper, oregano and chilli flakes, finished with coriander, chaat masala and lime. One high-protein serving.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp in pan + 1/2 tsp in sauce

steps: Melt the butter in a pan on medium heat. Add the bay leaf, garlic and onions and sauté until the onions are golden brown.
Add the mushrooms (stems and caps separated) and 1 teaspoon salt. Cook about 5 minutes until the water has evaporated.
Meanwhile, blend the low-fat paneer, half a teaspoon of salt, black pepper, oregano, chilli flakes and 150 ml water until smooth.
Pour the paneer sauce over the mushrooms and cook about 10 minutes until everything comes together.
Stir in chopped coriander and chaat masala. Turn off the heat and finish with the lime juice.

name: High-protein egg salad with curd
creator: See source link
description: No-cook salad of chopped boiled eggs, cucumber, tomato, onion and coriander, bound with thick curd and seasoned with roasted cumin, chilli flakes and chaat masala. Quick, creamy and high in protein. One serving.
steps: Chop the boiled eggs finely and put them in a bowl.
Add chopped cucumber, onion, tomato and coriander.
Add the thick curd and mix gently.
Season with roasted cumin powder, chilli flakes, chaat masala and salt. Mix and serve right away.

name: Egg, avocado and Gouda breakfast sandwich
creator: See source link
description: Quick breakfast sandwich of toasted brioche layered with cooked eggs, Gouda, sliced cherry tomatoes, avocado and crisp iceberg lettuce. Ready in about 10 minutes. One filling serving.

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.amount: handful of cherry tomatoes, sliced (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.amount: for cooking, or use oil (weight estimated)

steps: Toast the two brioche slices.
Cook the eggs in a little butter or oil in a pan and season with salt and pepper.
Put the Gouda slice on one toast, then add the eggs, sliced cherry tomatoes, avocado and lettuce.
Close with the second toast and serve right away.

name: Creamy classic egg salad
creator: See source link
description: Chopped hard-boiled egg whites folded into a mashed yolk dressing of mayonnaise, mustard, pickle juice, lemon, hot sauce and spices, with fresh dill and chives added just before serving. Makes a big batch, about 6 servings of 2 eggs each (servings assumed).
steps: Separate the yolks from the whites. Chop the whites finely and put them in a bowl.
Add the mayonnaise, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickle juice, lemon juice, spices and hot sauce to the yolks.
Mash the yolks with a fork and mix until creamy.
Mix the yolk mixture into the chopped egg whites until well combined.
Chill in the fridge for about 1 hour. Just before serving, gently fold in the chopped dill and chives.

name: Chickpea peanut protein salad
creator: See source link
description: No-cook salad of boiled chickpeas and boiled peanuts tossed with finely chopped cucumber, onion, tomato and coriander, seasoned with salt and black pepper. Simple and high in plant protein. Servings assumed as 2.
steps: Finely chop the cucumber, onion, tomato and coriander leaves.
Add the soaked and boiled chickpeas and the boiled peanuts.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Mix well and serve.

name: Creamy green high-protein salad bowl
creator: See source link
description: Fresh lettuce bowl with julienned carrot, cucumber and boiled sweet corn, topped with a creamy green dressing blended from spinach, tofu (or paneer), cashews and basic spices. High in protein and fibre, light in calories. One serving.

ingredients.name: Iceberg lettuce
ingredients.amount: fresh lettuce, as the base (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.amount: for the dressing, or use paneer (weight estimated)

steps: Put the lettuce, julienned carrot and cucumber and boiled sweet corn in a bowl as the base.
Blend the spinach, tofu (or paneer), cashews and spices into a creamy green dressing, adding a little water if needed.
Pour the dressing over the vegetables, toss and serve.

name: Low-calorie egg frankie
creator: See source link
description: High-protein egg wrap: a chapati is pressed onto beaten eggs cooking in a pan, then filled with a spiced curd sauce, a crunchy cucumber, cabbage, carrot and onion mix, and low-fat mozzarella. Rolled tight and lightly toasted. One serving.

ingredients.name: Chapati
ingredients.amount: 1 whole wheat chapati or tortilla (weight estimated)

steps: Beat the eggs well. Heat the butter in a pan and pour in the eggs.
Place the chapati on top of the eggs and flip it so the egg sticks to the chapati. Take it off the pan.
Mix the curd with chilli powder, cumin powder, garam masala and salt to make the sauce.
Toss the cucumber, cabbage or lettuce, carrot and onion with lime juice and chaat masala.
Spread the sauce and the vegetable mix over the egg side of the chapati and top with shredded mozzarella.
Roll it up tight, toast lightly with a little butter and serve warm.

name: Quick dahi tadka
creator: See source link
description: Five-minute summer side: a hot tadka of ghee, cumin, garlic, onion, turmeric and degi mirch, poured over 500 g of yogurt with a little sugar and salt, then topped with chopped coriander. Cooling and quick. Servings assumed as 4.
steps: Heat the ghee in a pan. Add the cumin seeds and chopped garlic.
Add the chopped onion and saute briefly.
Stir in turmeric, degi mirch, salt and sugar.
Pour the hot tadka over the yogurt.
Garnish with chopped coriander and serve.

name: High-protein chicken wrap
creator: See source link
description: Diced chicken breast marinated in curd, ginger-garlic paste, mustard and spices, cooked covered, then browned separately. Wrapped in a whole wheat tortilla or leftover roti with the pan gravy and tossed vegetables. Good for meal prep. Makes 2 wraps.

ingredients.name: Yellow mustard
ingredients.amount: 1 spoon mustard paste or sauce (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Bell pepper
ingredients.amount: favourite veggies, assumed bell pepper (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Chapati
ingredients.amount: 2 whole wheat tortillas or leftover rotis (weight estimated)

steps: Mix the diced chicken with curd, ginger-garlic paste, mustard, coriander powder, chilli powder, black pepper, chilli flakes and salt. Leave it to marinate as long as you can.
Grease a pan, add all the marinated chicken, cover and cook about 15 minutes until done.
Separate the chicken pieces from the gravy. Roast the pieces in the pan until golden brown.
Toss chopped onion and your favourite vegetables with seasoning.
Fill a tortilla or leftover roti with the gravy, roasted chicken and vegetables, roll and serve.

name: Peanut and roasted chana protein chaat
creator: Nitesh Soni
description: Two-minute no-cook breakfast or snack of peanuts and roasted chana mixed with chopped cucumber, onion and tomato, finished with lemon juice, salt and coriander. Cheap, filling and high in protein. One serving.
steps: Put the peanuts and roasted chana in a bowl.
Add chopped cucumber, onion and tomato.
Squeeze lemon juice on top and add salt and chopped coriander.
Mix well and eat right away.

name: Bachelor chicken curry
creator: See source link
description: Simple one-pan chicken curry: onions browned in coconut oil, then garlic, ginger and dry-roasted Kashmiri chilli, coriander and turmeric, bone-in chicken thighs, curry leaves and tomato. Simmered 30 minutes and finished with garam masala and black pepper. Serves 3.

ingredients.name: Red chilli powder
ingredients.amount: 1.5 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli powder (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Chicken thigh
ingredients.amount: 600 g bone-in skinless thighs, about 450 g meat (estimated)

steps: Heat the coconut oil in a pan on medium heat. Add the sliced onions and salt and saute about 5 minutes until golden.
Add the chopped garlic and ginger and mix well.
Add turmeric, Kashmiri chilli powder and coriander powder. Dry roast about 30 seconds, then mix into the onions.
Add the chicken thighs and mix well.
Add the curry leaves and chopped tomato. Cook about 5 minutes.
Pour in 1 to 2 cups hot water, depending on how thick you like it. Cover and cook about 30 minutes.
Stir in garam masala and black pepper and serve.

name: Pepper egg chops
creator: See source link
description: Three peppery omelettes made from 6 whisked eggs, slid into a smooth gravy of onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, fennel, cumin and pepper, finished with curry leaves. A spicy, protein-rich egg dish. Makes 3 omelettes, one per serving.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp for the eggs + 1/2 tsp for the masala (about 9 g)

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.amount: 1/2 tsp on each omelette + 1 tsp in the masala (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Fennel seeds
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp in the masala + 1 tsp for the gravy

steps: Whisk the eggs with 1 teaspoon of salt. Make 3 omelettes using about 1 tablespoon of oil in total, sprinkle each with black pepper and set aside.
In a pan on medium heat, add oil, black pepper, fennel seeds, cumin seeds, ginger, garlic, chopped onions, tomatoes, turmeric and salt.
Cook about 5 minutes until the onions and tomatoes soften, then blend to a smooth paste.
In the same pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil and add fennel seeds and curry leaves.
Add the blended paste and 150 ml of water and mix well. Cook about 5 minutes.
Gently slide in the omelettes, coat them with the gravy and serve.

name: Rajasthani dhungri tadka chutney
creator: See source link
description: Quick raw chutney of chopped onion, tomato, coriander and green chilli mixed with ground roasted peanuts and garlic, red chilli powder and salt, finished with hot mustard oil poured over the top. Eaten as a side. Servings assumed as 6 small portions.
steps: In a bowl, add the finely chopped onion, tomatoes, coriander and green chilli.
Grind the roasted peanuts and garlic together and add them to the bowl.
Add the red chilli powder and salt.
Pour the piping hot mustard oil over the mixture, mix well and serve.

name: Five-minute omelette curry
creator: See source link
description: Quick masala omelette: beaten eggs with onion, green chilli, turmeric and pepper are poured over a fried masala of cumin, curry leaves, garlic, onion and spice powders, then cooked briefly and flipped. Ready in about 5 minutes. One serving.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.amount: 1/4 onion in the eggs + 3/4 in the masala (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Turmeric powder
ingredients.amount: 1/4 tsp in the eggs + 1/2 tsp in the masala

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: 1/2 tsp in the eggs + 1/2 tsp in the masala

ingredients.name: Red chilli powder
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli powder (weight estimated)

steps: Beat the eggs with a quarter of the chopped onion, green chilli, a quarter teaspoon of turmeric, pepper and half a teaspoon of salt. Set aside.
Heat oil in a pan on medium heat. Add cumin seeds, curry leaves, garlic and the remaining chopped onion. Saute until the onion is golden brown.
Add Kashmiri chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder, garam masala and the remaining salt. Mix well.
Pour the beaten eggs over the masala, spread evenly and lower the flame. Cook about 1 minute until the bottom is set.
Flip the omelette carefully, turn off the heat and serve.

name: Spicy Kerala prawn fry
creator: See source link
description: Prawns coated in a blended paste of Kashmiri chilli, turmeric, fennel, pepper, shallots, garlic and ginger, then pan-fried in ghee with curry leaves and chilli flakes. Marinate 30 minutes or cook straight away. Quick, spicy and high in protein. One serving.

ingredients.name: Red chilli powder
ingredients.amount: 1.5 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli powder (weight estimated)

steps: Blend the chilli powder, turmeric, salt, fennel seeds, peppercorns, shallots, garlic, ginger and 50 ml water into a smooth paste.
Mix the prawns with the paste until well coated. Marinate 30 minutes, or cook straight away.
Heat the ghee in a pan on medium heat. Add half the curry leaves and wait until they crackle.
Add the prawns and cook 2 minutes.
Add the remaining curry leaves and chilli flakes, flip the prawns and fry 2 more minutes. Serve hot.

name: High-protein moong dal moonglet with amchur chaat masala chutney
creator: See source link
description: Savoury pancakes (moonglets) made from a blended soaked moong dal batter with onion, tomato, carrot, capsicum, green chilli and coriander, lightened with Eno and cooked crisp in a pan. Served with a tangy amchur and chaat masala chutney. Serves 5, with the whole chutney batch counted in the nutrition.

ingredients.name: Moong dal
ingredients.amount: 1 cup, soaked 3 to 4 hours (dry weight, estimated)

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: to taste, batter and chutney (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Cumin seeds
ingredients.amount: 1.5 tbsp roasted cumin powder, for the chutney (weight estimated)

steps: Soak the moong dal 3 to 4 hours or overnight, then drain and rinse well.
Blend the dal with ginger, turmeric and a little water into a smooth batter about as thick as pancake batter.
Move the batter to a bowl and mix in the onion, tomato, green chilli, cumin, carrot, capsicum, salt, coriander and curry leaves. Add the Eno and mix gently.
Heat a small pan on medium heat with a few drops of oil. Pour in a ladle of batter and spread it into a round.
Drizzle a little oil around the edges, cover and cook on medium-low heat until the bottom is golden and crisp.
Flip it, add a little more oil if needed, poke a few holes with a knife, cover again and cook until crisp on both sides.
Repeat with the rest of the batter.

For the chutney, mix the water, amchur, sugar, chaat masala, pepper, roasted cumin powder, black salt, chilli powder and salt. Boil in a hot pan about 2 minutes, then turn off the heat. It thickens as it cools.

name: High-protein black chana tikkis with paneer chipotle dip
creator: See source link
description: Pan-fried tikkis made from boiled black chana, sweet potato and beetroot, bound with roasted besan. Served with a creamy blended paneer, yogurt and soaked red chilli dip. Serves 4 assumed (about 8 tikkis), with the whole dip counted in the nutrition.

ingredients.name: Beetroot
ingredients.amount: 3/4 cup, boiled and chopped (weight estimated; boiled beetroot is close to raw values)

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.amount: part of 1 tbsp ginger-green chilli paste (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Green chilli
ingredients.amount: part of 1 tbsp ginger-green chilli paste (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: to taste, tikkis and dip (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Besan (gram flour)
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp roasted besan, for binding (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 2 to 3 tbsp for shallow frying (about 2 tbsp counted, as some stays in the pan)

ingredients.name: Dried red chilli
ingredients.amount: 2 to 4 red chillies soaked in hot water, 3 assumed (weight estimated)

steps: Coarsely mash the boiled black chana with the boiled sweet potato and boiled beetroot.
Add the ginger-green chilli paste, chaat masala, roasted cumin powder and salt, and mix well.
Mix in the roasted besan so the mixture holds together, then shape into tikkis.
Shallow fry the tikkis in oil on a pan until crisp and golden on both sides.
Blend the paneer, yogurt, garlic, soaked red chillies and salt until smooth to make the dip.
Serve the tikkis with the dip and top with chopped coriander.

name: Soya beetroot ragi cheela
creator: See source link
description: Savoury ragi pancakes with blended soaked soya chunks, grated beetroot and carrot, onion and coriander, cooked crisp on both sides in a pan. Serves 3 assumed (about 6 cheelas). Best eaten fresh with a spicy chutney.

ingredients.name: Soya chunks
ingredients.amount: 1 cup raw, soaked in hot water (dry weight, estimated)

steps: Blend the soaked soya chunks with the green chillies and ginger.
Mix the blended soya with the ragi flour, onion, carrot, beetroot, coriander, cumin seeds and salt, adding hot water to make a thick batter that is not too watery.
Let the batter rest for 5 to 10 minutes.
Grease a hot pan, spread the batter into a round and cook until crisp on both sides, adding a little oil or ghee if you like.
Serve hot with a spicy chutney.

name: High-protein chicken burger with besan veggie buns
creator: See source link
description: Grilled minced chicken breast patties with a melted low-calorie cheese slice, served between pan-fried carrot, cabbage and besan buns with a Greek yogurt burger sauce and lettuce. Serves 2 (two burgers); the sauce quantity is estimated.

ingredients.name: Carrot
ingredients.amount: 1 carrot, shredded, for the buns (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Cabbage
ingredients.amount: a small portion, shredded, for the buns (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Sesame seeds
ingredients.amount: optional sprinkle on the buns (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: to taste, buns and patties (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Yellow mustard
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp mustard sauce, for the sauce

ingredients.name: Chilli flakes
ingredients.amount: a pinch, for the sauce (weight estimated)

steps: Mix the shredded carrot and cabbage with the besan, peri peri masala, salt and a little water into a thick batter.
Grease a pan with olive oil, divide the batter into two, and cook each bun until done on both sides. Sprinkle sesame seeds on top if you like.
Mix the minced chicken with the chopped onion, soy sauce, chilli sauce and salt, then divide into two patties.
Grill the patties until cooked through and slightly charred.
Place a cheese slice on one patty, cover and cook on low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until it melts.
Stir together the Greek yogurt, ketchup, mustard, honey and chilli flakes for the burger sauce.
Assemble the buns, patties, sauce and lettuce or other veggies, and serve.

name: High-protein paneer pizza toast
creator: See source link
description: Multigrain bread topped with a filling of grated low-fat paneer, carrot, capsicum, onion and Greek yogurt with pizza sauce, finished with mozzarella and cooked covered in a pan until crisp underneath. Serves 2 (4 slices assumed).

ingredients.name: Greek yogurt
ingredients.amount: 85 g high-protein Greek yogurt or curd

ingredients.name: Multigrain bread
ingredients.amount: 4 slices, no-maida multigrain (number of slices assumed)

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.amount: for the pan, butter or olive oil (amount assumed)

steps: Mix the grated paneer with the carrot, capsicum, onion, Greek yogurt, pizza sauce, salt, pepper, oregano and chilli flakes.
Spread the filling over the bread slices and top with mozzarella.
Melt a little butter or olive oil in a pan and place the bread in it.
Cover and cook on low heat until the cheese melts and the base turns crispy.
Sprinkle a little more seasoning on top and serve hot.

name: Crispy paneer in butter garlic sauce
creator: See source link
description: Low-fat paneer coated in a soy, pepper and corn flour mix, pan-fried in ghee until golden, then tossed in a creamy garlic, butter, milk and cream sauce with coriander, honey and chilli oil. Serves 3.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp pepper powder, for the marinade (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Ghee
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp, for frying the paneer (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp chopped, for the sauce (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Green garlic shoots
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp chopped, for the sauce (weight estimated)

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp chilli oil, counted as vegetable oil (weight estimated)

steps: Coat the paneer with the ginger garlic paste, corn flour, pepper, chilli flakes, soy sauce and salt.
Heat ghee in a pan on medium heat and cook the paneer in a single spaced-out layer for about 5 minutes until golden and crispy. Set aside.
In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the chopped garlic and green garlic shoots.
Add the soy sauce, pepper and cream and mix well.
Pour in the milk and cook about 2 minutes until the sauce turns creamy.
Return the crispy paneer to the pan, add the coriander and honey, and cook another 2 minutes.
Switch off the heat, drizzle over the chilli oil, give a final mix and serve.

name: One-pan chicken and egg rice
creator: See source link
description: Raw rice, chicken breast, egg, onion and garlic mixed with garam masala, chilli and pepper, fried briefly, then cooked covered with water until the rice is done. Serves 2. Spices can be doubled for more flavour.
steps: Mix the raw rice, eggs, chicken, chopped onion, garlic, salt, garam masala, chilli powder and pepper well.
Fry the mixture on medium heat for 3 to 5 minutes.
Add 1 cup of water, cover and cook on low heat for about 15 minutes until the rice is done.
Double the spices if you like it more flavourful.

name: White chicken kadhai with yogurt and cream
creator: See source link
description: Chicken thighs simmered with whole spices, onion purée, ginger-garlic, yogurt and plenty of black pepper, then finished with fresh cream, mozzarella and chopped ginger, green chilli and coriander. Mild, creamy and high in protein. Serves 2.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.amount: 2 onions, blended to a purée (size assumed)

ingredients.name: Chicken thigh
ingredients.amount: 500 g bone-in, skinless (about 400 g meat, assumed)

steps: Heat ghee in a pan on medium heat. Add cumin seeds, cloves and cardamom and fry for about a minute until fragrant.
Blend the onions into a smooth purée, add to the pan and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw smell goes.
Add the chicken and salt, mix well and cook for 5 minutes.
Add coriander powder, cumin powder, black pepper and yogurt. Mix well.
Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Uncover and stir. Add the cream and mozzarella (or cheese slices) and cook for 5 more minutes.
Finish with chopped ginger, green chilli and coriander. Serve hot.

name: Hariyali soya rice
creator: See source link
description: Basmati rice cooked with golden onion and soya chunks in a blended paste of coriander, mint, ginger, garlic, green chilli and whole spices. Fragrant, green and filling. Serves 3.

ingredients.name: Coriander leaves
ingredients.amount: a handful in the blender (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Coriander leaves
ingredients.amount: a handful added while boiling (weight assumed)

steps: Blend coriander, mint, ginger, garlic, green chilli, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom, cumin, fennel and 150 ml water into a smooth green paste.
Heat oil in a pan on medium heat. Add the chopped onion and soaked soya chunks.
Saute for about 10 minutes until the onion turns golden to dark brown.
Add the green paste and cook until the raw smell goes.
Add garam masala and salt and mix well.
Add 500 ml water and the washed rice, mix and bring to a boil.
When the water boils steadily, add a handful of coriander.
Cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 25 minutes. Serve hot.

name: High-protein chipotle sauce (no oil, no mayo)
creator: See source link
description: No-oil, no-mayo dressing blended from tofu, thick hung curd, soaked dried red chillies, soaked cashews and garlic. Creamy, spicy and high in protein. Good on salads, wraps, sandwiches and tacos. Servings assumed as 4.

ingredients.name: Yogurt
ingredients.amount: 1 cup hung curd or thick yogurt (weight assumed)

steps: Soak the dried red chillies and cashews in hot water until soft.
Put tofu, hung curd, soaked cashews, chillies, garlic and salt in a blender.
Blend until smooth, thick and creamy.
Use as a dressing or dip for salads, wraps, sandwiches, tacos and burgers.

name: Tandoori chicken salad with mint yogurt dressing
creator: See source link
description: Chicken breast marinated in curd, tandoori masala and lemon, pan-grilled until dry and charred, then tossed with lettuce, capsicum, tomato and onion in a mint-coriander Greek yogurt dressing. One high-protein serving.

ingredients.name: Coriander leaves
ingredients.amount: a handful, 2 parts to 1 of mint (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Greek yogurt
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp in the paste plus 80 g high-protein Greek yogurt

steps: Mix chicken with curd, tandoori masala, lemon juice and a pinch of salt. Rest for 30 minutes if you have time (optional).
Heat olive oil in a pan, add the chicken, cover and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until cooked through.
Uncover and cook until the water dries and both sides are well grilled.
Blend coriander, mint (2 parts to 1), garlic, chilli sauce, a pinch of salt, 1 tbsp Greek yogurt and honey into a paste.
Mix the paste into 80 g Greek yogurt to make the dressing.
Toss lettuce, capsicum, tomato and onion with the chicken and dressing. Serve at once.

name: High-protein kesar pista chia pudding
creator: See source link
description: Greek yogurt blended with almonds, pistachios, saffron milk, dates, cardamom and vanilla protein powder, then set in three jars with chia seeds and topped with strawberries. Creamy, high in protein and fibre. Makes 3 jars.

ingredients.name: Strawberries
ingredients.amount: any fruit or berries to top (weight assumed)

steps: Soak the saffron strands in 120 ml milk.
Blend Greek yogurt, almonds, pistachios, saffron milk, dates, cardamom, protein powder and salt until smooth.
Pour the mix evenly into 3 containers.
Add about 20 g chia seeds to each container and mix well.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours until fully set.
Top with strawberries or other fruit and serve.

name: Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls
creator: See source link
description: Spiced chicken and peppers folded into a creamy garlic parmesan sauce, rolled in flour tortillas with mozzarella and pan-fried until crisp, served with extra sauce for dipping. Makes 10 rolls, about 5 servings of 2 rolls (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: to taste, chicken and sauce (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp for chicken plus 1/2 tsp for sauce

ingredients.name: Garlic powder
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp for chicken plus 1 tsp for sauce

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp marinade, 2 tbsp cooking, about 2 tbsp for frying (frying amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp finely chopped plus garnish (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Flour tortilla
ingredients.amount: 9 to 10 small wraps (about 30 g each, assumed)

steps: Mix the chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice and 1 tbsp oil.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet on medium-high. Cook the chicken until done and lightly golden.
Add diced onion and bell pepper and saute for 2 to 3 minutes until soft. Set aside.
Melt butter on medium-low, add garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add cream, cream cheese, salt, pepper, garlic powder and chilli flakes. Whisk smooth and simmer until slightly thick.
Lower the heat, stir in the parmesan until melted, then switch off and add parsley.
Keep half the sauce for dipping. Mix the other half into the chicken and let it cool a little.
Spoon filling onto each tortilla, add mozzarella, fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Pan-fry the rolls seam-side down in a little oil on medium to medium-low heat, turning until golden and crisp on all sides.
Top with parsley and parmesan and serve hot with the reserved sauce.

name: Chikkar chole (creamy mashed chickpea curry)
creator: See source link
description: Pressure-cooked chickpeas simmered in an onion, ginger and chana masala gravy thickened with blended potato and high-protein Greek yogurt, then finished with a ghee, kasuri methi and green chilli tadka. Thick, slightly mushy and filling. Serves 3. Needs overnight soaking.

ingredients.name: Dried chickpeas
ingredients.amount: 250 g kabuli chana, soaked overnight (dry weight)

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp for cooking plus 1/2 tsp in gravy

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.amount: 1 inch chopped (15 g) plus 8 g juliennes for tadka

ingredients.name: Green chilli
ingredients.amount: 2 chopped plus 2 slit for tadka (weight assumed)

steps: Soak the dried chickpeas overnight (about 8 hours), then drain and rinse.
Put chickpeas, the potato halves, bay leaf, salt and water to cover in a pressure cooker. Cook 4 to 5 whistles on high, then 5 minutes on low. In an electric cooker, 20 minutes.
Blend the cooked potato, 1 tbsp cooked chickpeas, Greek yogurt and a splash of cooker water until smooth.
Heat mustard oil, add onions, ginger and green chillies and cook until golden, about 3 minutes.
Add turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder and chana masala and mix well.
Pour in the potato-yogurt mix and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the chickpeas with some cooking liquid, brown sugar and salt. Simmer about 15 minutes until thick and slightly mushy.
Heat ghee, add slit green chillies, ginger, kasuri methi and hing. When it sizzles, pour over the chole.
Garnish with coriander and serve.

name: 15-minute high-protein peri-peri mushroom
creator: See source link
description: Dry-cooked mushrooms sauteed with garlic and onion, then coated in a blended sauce of high-protein paneer, peri-peri seasoning and Kashmiri chilli, finished with oregano and coriander. Creamy, spicy and ready in about 15 minutes. Serves 2, good with roti or herb rice.
steps: Heat a pan and cook the chopped mushrooms without oil until all the water has evaporated.
Add the oil, garlic and onion and saute for 4 to 5 minutes.
Blend the paneer, peri-peri seasoning and Kashmiri chilli powder into a smooth paste, adding a little water if needed.
Mix chilli flakes into the mushrooms.
Pour in the paneer paste and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Sprinkle oregano and coriander and serve hot with roti or herb rice.

name: Burger salad bowl with crispy paneer and peri-peri fries
creator: See source link
description: A bun-free burger bowl: tangy grated carrot, cucumber and onion salad with lettuce, air-fried peri-peri potato fries and crispy peri-peri paneer, drizzled with a creamy cashew and red chilli sauce. Best eaten fresh. Serves 2 (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.amount: 1 thinly sliced for salad plus chopped onion to finish (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: for salad, boiling water and sauce (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Potato
ingredients.amount: 2 to 3 potatoes, cut into fries (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Peri peri masala
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp for fries plus 1 1/2 tbsp for paneer (weight assumed)

steps: Mix grated carrot, cucumber and sliced onion with salt, pepper and vinegar. Set aside.
Boil the potato fries in salted water for 7 minutes, drain well and toss with oil and peri-peri masala.
Air fry the fries at 200 C for 9 minutes.
Meanwhile toss the paneer with cornflour, peri-peri masala and a splash of water.
Add the paneer to the air fryer with the fries and cook at 200 C for 9 to 10 more minutes until crispy.
Blend boiled cashews, boiled red chillies, garlic, honey, salt and a little water into a smooth creamy sauce.
Layer lettuce, salad, fries and paneer in a bowl. Drizzle with the sauce and top with chopped onion.

name: Lauki moong rice
creator: See source link
description: One-pan rice cooked with grated lauki, moong dal, onion, green chilli and curry leaves, finished with coriander and lemon juice. Serve with sauteed paneer, cucumber and curd for a balanced meal (sides not counted). Meal-prep friendly. Makes about 3 servings (servings assumed). Soak the dal and rice first.
steps: Soak the moong dal and rice beforehand.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds and bay leaf and let them sizzle.
Add sliced onion, green chillies and curry leaves and saute until the onion softens.
Add grated lauki and soaked moong dal, mix and cook for 7 to 8 minutes.
Add soaked rice, water and salt. Mix, cover and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until rice and dal are done.
Switch off the heat and finish with coriander and lemon juice.
Serve with sauteed paneer, cucumber and curd.

name: Oats and paneer base veggie pizza
creator: See source link
description: No-oven, no-yeast pizza with a base of oats flour, grated paneer and curd cooked on a tawa, spread with a homemade tomato-garlic sauce and topped with mushrooms, capsicum, corn, high-protein paneer and cheese. Makes 2 pizzas, one per serving (servings and cheese amount assumed).

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.amount: 1 chopped for sauce plus 1 chopped for topping (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: to taste across sauce, topping and base (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Oregano
ingredients.amount: to taste for sauce and topping (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 2 tsp for topping plus a little for brushing (amount assumed)

steps: Brush a pan with a little oil, place tomatoes cut-side down and add onion, garlic and salt. Cover and cook until soft.
Peel off the tomato skins and mash everything. Add coriander, water, tomato sauce, oregano and red chilli powder and cook a few minutes into a sauce.
For the topping, saute the mushrooms until their water dries. Add oil, onion, capsicum and sweet corn and cook 4 to 5 minutes.
Add chopped paneer, salt, chilli flakes and oregano, cook a few more minutes and set aside.
Mix oats flour, grated paneer, curd, honey and salt into a semi-soft dough.
Roll out the dough and cook the base on a tawa on both sides.
Spread sauce on the base, add the topping and cheese. Cover and cook until the cheese melts, or air fry for a crisper finish.

name: Crispy schezwan paneer (air-fried)
creator: See source link
description: Paneer cubes dipped in a cornflour slurry, coated in crushed cornflakes and air-fried until crisp, then tossed in a quick schezwan, honey and Kashmiri chilli sauce and finished with spring onion. No deep frying. Serves 2 (paneer amount and servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Corn flour
ingredients.amount: 5 to 6 tbsp for slurry plus 1 tsp for sauce

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: to taste, slurry and sauce (amount assumed)

steps: Mix cornflour, black pepper, oregano, chilli flakes and salt, adding water gradually to make a thick slurry.
Dip the paneer cubes in the slurry and coat well with crushed cornflakes.
Air fry until golden and crispy.
Heat oil in a pan, add schezwan sauce, cornflour, Kashmiri chilli powder, honey and salt and cook until thick.
Add the crispy paneer, toss to coat, top with spring onion and serve immediately.

name: High-protein Afghani soya kofta
creator: See source link
description: Pan-cooked koftas of blended soya chunks and high-protein paneer in a creamy white Afghani-style gravy of caramelised onion, garlic, cashew, whole spices and curd, finished with cream and fresh coriander. Makes 4 servings.

ingredients.name: Soya chunks
ingredients.amount: 50 g boiled and squeezed (about 22 g dry weight, assumed)

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.amount: 1 small chopped for koftas plus 2 sliced for gravy (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Green chilli
ingredients.amount: 2 to 3 in koftas plus 4 to 5 in gravy (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Coriander powder
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp in koftas plus 1 tbsp in gravy (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Garam masala
ingredients.amount: a pinch in koftas plus 1 tsp in gravy

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: to taste, koftas and gravy (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Ghee
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp to brush the pan plus 1 tsp for spices

ingredients.name: Coriander leaves
ingredients.amount: a handful, for gravy and garnish (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Fresh cream
ingredients.amount: low-fat cream to garnish, optional (amount assumed)

steps: Heat a pan brushed with 1 tsp ghee. Caramelise the sliced onions, garlic, green chillies, cashews and whole spices.
Mix blended soya chunks, paneer, chopped onion, green chillies, ginger-garlic paste, coriander powder, red chilli powder, garam masala, salt and besan. Shape into koftas and pan-cook until golden.
Remove the cinnamon stick and blend the caramelised mix with coriander and a little water until smooth.
Heat 1 tsp ghee and 2 tsp butter. Add the powdered spices and roast for 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the blended paste, salt, sugar and water and cook for 4 to 5 minutes.
Turn the heat fully low and stir in the room-temperature curd continuously until smooth, then bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the koftas and simmer 2 to 3 minutes. Garnish with cream and coriander and serve hot.

name: Air-fried sweet and spicy sesame chickpeas
creator: See source link
description: Soaked and pressure-cooked chickpeas tossed in peanut butter, honey, chilli oil and black and white sesame seeds, then air-fried until crunchy. A sweet, spicy, nutty snack, topped with spring onion. Needs overnight soaking. Makes about 4 servings (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: to taste, for cooking and coating (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Sesame seeds
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp black plus 1 tbsp white (weight assumed)

steps: Wash the dried chickpeas and soak them in plenty of water overnight for 8 to 10 hours.
Drain, then pressure cook with fresh water and salt for 3 whistles until tender but not mushy.
Drain really well and let them sit a few minutes so the extra moisture dries off.
Mix with peanut butter, honey, chilli oil, salt and both sesame seeds until every chickpea is coated.
Air fry at 180 C for 30 to 35 minutes, tossing once or twice for even crispness.
Let them cool completely so they turn extra crunchy.
Top with chopped spring onion and serve.

name: High-protein kala chana veggie kebab
creator: See source link
description: Soft kebabs of blended pressure-cooked black chickpeas, cooked onion, carrot, beetroot, beans and cauliflower, thickened with roasted besan and shallow-fried in ghee until golden. Serve with paratha and chutney. Makes about 12 kebabs, 4 servings of 3 (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: for brushing the pan and palms (amount assumed)

steps: Brush oil in a pan and cook the onion, carrot, beetroot, beans, cauliflower, green chillies, garlic and salt until soft.
Add coriander powder, Kashmiri chilli powder and garam masala, cook 5 to 6 minutes and let it cool.
Blend the boiled kala chana, the cooked vegetables and 1 cup water until smooth.
Dry roast the besan for 4 to 5 minutes, add the blended mix and cook 7 to 8 minutes until thick.
Brush oil on your palms and shape the mix into kebabs.
Brush ghee on a pan and cook the kebabs on both sides until golden.
Serve hot with paratha and chutney.

name: Guilt-free malai kofta
creator: See source link
description: Lighter malai kofta: paneer and potato koftas stuffed with nuts and raisins, cooked in a paniyaram pan with little ghee, served in a creamy gravy of pressure-cooked carrot, pumpkin, tomato, garlic and cashew finished with milk and kasuri methi. Makes about 12 koftas, 4 servings of 3 (servings assumed). Malai and chilli-ghee tadka are optional and not counted.

ingredients.name: Almonds
ingredients.amount: a few roasted nuts for stuffing (nut type and weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Ghee
ingredients.amount: to brush the paniyaram pan (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Ghee
ingredients.amount: to brush the pan for the curry (amount assumed)

steps: Pressure cook the carrot, pumpkin, tomatoes, garlic, dried red chillies and cashews with a cup of water for 3 whistles. Let the pressure release naturally.
Cool the cooked vegetables fully, then blend into a smooth paste for the gravy.
Mix the grated paneer, mashed potato, maida, chopped green chillies, ginger, coriander and salt. Knead with the base of your palm into a smooth dough.
Roast a few nuts and raisins and chop them roughly for the filling.
Flatten a small portion of dough, put some filling in the middle, and roll into a smooth ball. Repeat with the rest.
Brush a paniyaram pan with ghee and cook the koftas, turning, until golden on all sides. Keep aside.
In a pan brushed with ghee, sauté the cinnamon, cardamom and coriander powder for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the vegetable paste, salt and red chilli powder and mix well. Pour in the milk and cook until the gravy thickens.
Crush the kasuri methi between your palms and stir it in.
Spoon gravy into a bowl, place the koftas on top and add more gravy. Optionally finish with malai, a chilli-ghee tadka and fresh coriander.

name: Hot honey garlic chicken bread
creator: See source link
description: Cheesy garlic bread loaf topped with spiced, pan-cooked chicken breast pieces, mozzarella and Parmesan, baked until bubbly and finished with a hot honey drizzle. Served with a hot honey garlic aioli for dipping. Makes 1 large loaf, 4 servings (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp for the chicken plus a little to cook (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Garlic powder
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp for chicken, 1/2 tsp for garlic butter

ingredients.name: Smoked paprika
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp chicken, 1/2 tsp hot honey, 1/4 tsp aioli

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: chicken, hot honey, garlic butter and aioli, to taste (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.amount: 4 tbsp salted butter for garlic butter plus 1 tsp for hot honey

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp in hot honey plus 1 tsp in aioli

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp minced plus 1 small clove for aioli

ingredients.name: Parsley
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp chopped in butter plus garnish (garnish weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Parmesan cheese
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp in butter, 1/4 cup on top, extra for garnish (weights assumed)

ingredients.name: French bread loaf
ingredients.amount: 1 large French or Italian loaf (weight assumed)

steps: Heat honey, hot sauce, chilli flakes, smoked paprika, butter, lemon juice and a pinch of salt in a small pan on low for 1 to 2 minutes until glossy. Set aside.
Toss the chicken pieces with olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, chilli powder, pepper, salt and cornstarch.
Cook the chicken in a hot oiled skillet for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring now and then, until browned and cooked through.
Mix softened butter with minced garlic, parsley, garlic powder, salt and Parmesan to make the garlic butter.
Mix mayonnaise, some of the hot honey, grated garlic, lemon juice, paprika and salt into a smooth aioli. Chill until serving.
Preheat the oven to 190 C (375 F). Slice the loaf in half lengthwise and spread the garlic butter generously on both halves.
Layer half the mozzarella, the hot honey chicken, the rest of the mozzarella and the Parmesan on the bread.
Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and the edges are golden. Grill for 1 to 2 minutes if you like, watching closely.
Drizzle with the remaining hot honey and garnish with parsley and Parmesan.
Slice and serve warm with the hot honey garlic aioli for dipping.

name: Chowmein spring rolls
creator: See source link
description: Crispy deep-fried spring rolls filled with saucy Indo-Chinese vegetable chowmein, wrapped in homemade thin sheets made from a maida and corn flour batter cooked in a nonstick pan. Makes 8 to 9 rolls, about 45 to 50 g filling each. Full chowmein batch counted, so any leftover chowmein is included. Serve with chaat masala and schezwan sauce (not counted).

ingredients.name: Maida (refined flour)
ingredients.amount: 2 to 3 tbsp for sealing slurry (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp for noodles plus 2 tbsp for stir-frying

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: oil absorbed during deep frying (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: 1/4 tsp in batter plus 1/4 tsp in chowmein (weight assumed)

steps: Whisk maida, corn flour, salt and water into a smooth, lump-free batter and let it rest.
Shred the cabbage, slice the capsicum, onion and carrot, cut the spring onion whites and greens separately, and chop ginger, garlic and green chilli fine.
Boil the noodles briefly until they separate, switch off the heat, cover and let them soften for 3 to 4 minutes. Drain, toss to let steam escape, and mix with a little oil.
Heat oil in a wok on high heat and sauté the ginger, garlic and green chilli for 30 seconds.
Add the onion, carrot, capsicum and cabbage and toss on high heat for 30 seconds.
Add ketchup, red chilli sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, white pepper and salt, then toss in the noodles and spring onions until evenly coated. Let the chowmein cool.
Stir the batter again. Heat a nonstick pan to moderate heat, pour in the batter, spread it thin and pour off any extra.
Cook the sheet for 30 to 40 seconds until it lifts by itself. Dust with corn flour, trim the edges and repeat with the remaining batter. Cover the sheets with a damp cloth.
Mix maida and water into a thick slurry to use as glue.
Place 45 to 50 g chowmein just below the centre of a sheet, brush slurry on the corners, fold in the sides tightly and roll up firmly. Seal with more slurry.
Heat oil to about 160 C and fry the rolls 2 or 3 at a time, leaving them untouched for the first minute, then turn gently on medium heat until light golden and crisp.
Drain the rolls, cut into pieces and serve with chaat masala and schezwan sauce.

name: Paneer maharaja
creator: See source link
description: Rich, creamy paneer curry with a smooth gravy of boiled onions, cashews and whole spices, roasted in butter with masala, then finished with paneer cubes, cheese slices and kasuri methi. Paneer amount not given, 200 g assumed for 2 servings.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.amount: peppercorns plus black pepper powder (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Garam masala
ingredients.amount: Magic Masala blend, approximated with garam masala (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Red chilli powder
ingredients.amount: in gravy and for garnish (amount assumed)

steps: Boil the onions, cashews and whole spices in water for 10 minutes.
Drain, keeping the water aside, and remove all the whole spices except the peppercorns.
Blend into a smooth paste, adding some of the reserved water as needed.
Heat butter in a pan, add the masala and roast for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the blended gravy and cook well, seasoning with salt, black pepper and red chilli powder.
Add the paneer cubes and cheese slices and cook, stirring, until creamy.
Garnish with crushed kasuri methi and a little red chilli powder and serve hot.

name: High-protein crispy chicken burger with oat buns
creator: See source link
description: Air-fried cornflake-crusted chicken breast in homemade egg and oat buns, with a high-protein Greek yogurt burger sauce of garlic, hot sauce and mustard, plus lettuce. One burger, 1 serving (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: for chicken, buns and sauce (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.amount: 1 to coat the chicken and 2 for the buns (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.amount: to grease the chicken and the pan (amount assumed)

steps: Marinate the chicken breast with salt, pepper and paprika.
Dip the chicken in whisked egg, then coat well with crushed cornflakes.
Grease lightly with oil and air fry at 200 C for 15 minutes, flipping halfway.
Mix the oats, 2 eggs and a pinch of salt into a batter.
Grease a pan with olive oil, pour the mixture in two bun-shaped rounds and cook 3 to 5 minutes, turning once, until both sides are done.
Blend the Greek yogurt, garlic, hot sauce, mustard, salt and pepper into a smooth sauce.
Spread sauce on an oat bun, add lettuce and the crispy chicken, top with the second bun and serve.

name: One-pan lemon chicken legs and rice
creator: See source link
description: Yogurt, oregano and mustard marinated chicken legs seared golden, then cooked on a bed of rice with onion, garlic, carrot and spinach in chicken stock with bay leaf and lemon slices. One pot, 4 servings (servings assumed). Marinating time of 30 minutes is not counted in prep time.

ingredients.name: Chicken thigh
ingredients.amount: 4 chicken legs, about 700 g bone-in with roughly 80% meat (weight assumed)

steps: Mix the chicken legs with yogurt, oregano, mustard, garlic, salt, pepper and olive oil. Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep pan and sear the legs 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden. Set aside, they do not need to cook through yet.
In the same pan, sauté the onion and garlic until soft, scraping up the browned bits.
Add the carrot and spinach and sauté briefly until they start to soften.
Drain the soaked rice, add it to the pan and sauté gently for a minute.

Set the seared chicken on the rice, pour in the stock, add the bay leaf and lay lemon slices on top. Cover and cook on low heat for 10 to 12 minutes until the rice and chicken are cooked through, adding more stock if needed.
Rest covered for 5 minutes, fluff the rice gently and serve hot with the chicken.

name: Creamy green paneer masala with mint and coriander
creator: See source link
description: Golden fried paneer simmered in a green gravy of onion, garlic, ginger, mint, coriander and dahi, slow-cooked with whole spices and ground masalas, then finished with cream, coriander and kasuri methi. Garnished with cream and chilli oil, served with rotis. 4 servings (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Coriander leaves
ingredients.amount: 1/2 cup for the paste plus chopped for finishing (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 1/4 cup for frying (about 30 g absorbed, assumed) plus 4 tbsp for the gravy

ingredients.name: Fresh cream
ingredients.amount: 3 tbsp to finish plus a little to garnish (weight assumed)

steps: Heat oil in a kadai and fry the paneer until golden on all sides. Drain and keep aside.
In the same kadai, fry the onions, ginger, garlic and green chillies on medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the onions are soft and translucent. Let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Blend the cooled mixture with mint, coriander, dahi and a little water into a smooth paste.
Add 2 tbsp oil to the kadai and fry the whole spices for 30 seconds.
Add the paste and cook covered on medium-low heat for 15 to 18 minutes, stirring now and then, until the masala dries up completely.
Add 2 tbsp more oil and the powdered spices and fry for 2 to 3 minutes. Season with salt and pour in the hot water.
Add the paneer and simmer for 5 minutes, then finish with cream, coriander and kasuri methi. Garnish with cream and chilli oil and serve hot with rotis.

name: Smoked dahi gosht (mutton curry)
creator: See source link
description: Pressure-cooked mutton curry in an onion and green chilli base with freshly ground dry roasted spices, finished with dahi, mint and garam masala. Smoked with a piece of hot charcoal and ghee, garnished with ginger julienne and coriander. 4 servings (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Mutton
ingredients.amount: 500 g curry cut, bone-in, about 80% meat (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp for the dry masala plus 1 tsp whole

ingredients.name: Ghee
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp plus about 1/2 to 1 tsp for smoking

ingredients.name: Cardamom pods
ingredients.amount: 2 to 3 green and 1 black cardamom (weight assumed)

steps: Dry roast the coriander seeds, cumin and peppercorns on low heat until lightly toasted. Cool and grind into a coarse powder.
Blend the onion and green chillies into a smooth paste, adding a little water if needed.
Heat ghee in a pressure cooker, add the whole spices, then the mutton and sauté 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned.
Add the ginger garlic paste and sauté until the raw smell goes.
Add the onion and chilli paste and sauté for 5 to 7 minutes.
Add turmeric and the ground spice blend and sauté until the masala is cooked.
Add 1 cup water and salt, close the lid and cook 4 to 5 whistles on medium heat.
Release the pressure, stir in the whisked dahi and mint and cook until the gravy thickens.
Heat a piece of charcoal until red hot, set it in a small heatproof bowl or foil inside the cooker, pour ghee over it and cover for 2 to 3 minutes to smoke the curry. Remove the charcoal.
Add garam masala, coriander and ginger julienne and cook for a couple of minutes. Serve hot.

name: Kerala-style surmai in coconut milk on banana leaf
creator: See source link
description: Surmai (seer fish) marinated in chilli, turmeric and pepper, part-cooked, then gently simmered on a banana leaf with curry leaves, coconut milk, green chilli and ginger, and finished with coconut oil. Banana leaf is not eaten and not counted. 1 piece of fish, 1 serving (200 g fish assumed).

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp for marinade plus 1 tsp for simmering

ingredients.name: Coconut oil
ingredients.amount: 3 tbsp for marinade and frying, 2 tsp for the pan, plus a little to finish; about 30 g counted as eaten (amount assumed)

steps: Mix the chilli powder, turmeric, pepper, salt and coconut oil into a marinade.
Coat the surmai with the marinade and rest for 30 minutes.
Cook the fish until about 80% done and set it aside.
Heat coconut oil in a pan and line it with banana leaves.
Spread curry leaves over the banana leaf and lay the fish on top.
Pour coconut milk over the fish and add the green chillies, ginger, pepper and salt.
Simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Finish with a little coconut oil and serve hot.

name: Masala makhana munchie mix
creator: See source link
description: Crunchy ghee-toasted makhana tossed with fried peanuts, cashews, almonds, curry leaves, dry coconut slices and roasted chana dal in chilli, pepper, chaat masala and a little sugar. Store in an airtight jar. Makes a big batch, 8 servings of about 55 g (servings assumed).
steps: Heat some of the ghee in a kadhai, add the makhana and toast on medium-low heat until crunchy. Set aside.
Add the rest of the ghee to the same kadhai and fry the peanuts, almonds and cashews until golden.
Add the curry leaves and torn dried red chillies and let them splutter.
Add the dry coconut slices and roasted chana dal and toss well.
Add chilli powder, turmeric, pepper, salt, chaat masala and sugar and mix.
Return the makhana and toss until the masala coats everything evenly.
Take it off the heat, let it cool completely and store in an airtight jar.

name: Almond yogurt masala chicken kadhai
creator: See source link
description: Bone-in chicken marinated in a blended base of yogurt, almonds, cashews and desiccated coconut with tomato, fried onions, herbs, green chillies, sauces and spices, then slow-cooked in ghee in its own juices. Finished with green chillies, coriander, cream and ginger. Marination of up to 3 hours not counted in prep time. 4 servings (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Chicken thigh
ingredients.amount: 500 g bone-in chicken, about 80% meat (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Hot sauce
ingredients.amount: 2 tsp red chilli sauce, 2 tsp green chilli sauce and 1 tbsp hot sauce (weight assumed)

steps: Blend the yogurt, almonds, cashews and desiccated coconut into a smooth paste.
In a bowl, mix the paste with blended tomatoes, fried onions, coriander, mint, slit green chillies, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice, soy sauce, the chilli and hot sauces, and all the spices.
Add the chicken and coat evenly. Cover and marinate for up to 3 hours.
Heat ghee in a kadhai, add the whole marinated chicken mixture, cover and cook on medium heat in its own juices.
When it starts to dry out, add hot water as needed and stir often. Cook another 20 to 25 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Finish with slit green chillies, coriander, cream and ginger julienne. Serve hot.

name: High-protein paneer cheese wrap
creator: See source link
description: Wrap made of grated paneer bound with low-calorie cheese in a nonstick pan, folded over a filling of shredded veggies in a high-protein Greek yogurt, mustard and ketchup mix. One wrap, 1 serving. Veggie quantities assumed.

ingredients.name: Cabbage
ingredients.amount: shredded veggies of your choice (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Carrot
ingredients.amount: shredded veggies of your choice (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Bell pepper
ingredients.amount: shredded veggies of your choice (weight assumed)

steps: Heat a nonstick pan and sprinkle a little low-calorie cheese on it.
Spread 100 g grated paneer over the cheese and top with more shredded cheese, about 15 to 20 g in all. Shape and press with a spatula.
Cook until the cheese binds the paneer and the spatula can lift it without breaking.
Mix the shredded veggies with the Greek yogurt, mustard sauce, ketchup, salt and pepper.
Spoon the filling onto the wrap base, fold and serve.

name: Cheese cucumber taco with peri peri tofu
creator: See source link
description: Low-fat mozzarella and thin cucumber slices crisped in a pan into a taco shell, filled with peri peri tofu grilled in the same pan, Greek yogurt taco sauce with coriander, lettuce and tomato. One serving, about 350 kcal as per the creator.

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: very little, to grease the pan (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Hot sauce
ingredients.amount: 1 spoon Mexican or other spicy tangy sauce (weight assumed)

steps: Grease a pan lightly, spread most of the mozzarella as the base, layer thin cucumber slices on top and sprinkle the rest of the cheese over.
Cook until the base turns brown, loosening it gently so it does not stick. Flip and cook 2 to 3 minutes on the other side.
Season the tofu with peri peri powder and grill it in the same pan without adding more oil.
Mix the Greek yogurt, spicy tangy sauce and chopped coriander into a taco sauce.
Fill the cheese shell with lettuce, tomato, tofu and sauce, and serve hot.

name: Mangalorean fish fry
creator: See source link
description: Fish pieces marinated in turmeric, salt and lemon juice, coated in a fine paste of Byadagi chillies, garlic, ginger, coriander, cumin, pepper, tamarind and curry leaves, then shallow-fried in oil with curry leaves. Marination of 30 minutes not counted in prep time. 3 pieces, 3 servings (fish type and 150 g per piece assumed).

ingredients.name: Surmai (seer fish)
ingredients.amount: 3 pieces, 150 g each (fish type and weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Lemon juice
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp for marinade plus 1 tbsp for paste

ingredients.name: Curry leaves
ingredients.amount: for the paste and for frying (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 3 tbsp for frying, about 30 g counted as eaten (amount assumed)

steps: Marinate the fish with salt, turmeric and lemon juice for 30 minutes.
Grind the Byadagi chillies, garlic, ginger, coriander seeds, cumin, pepper, tamarind pulp, curry leaves and lemon juice into a fine paste.
Heat oil in a pan, add curry leaves and fry the marinated fish.
Add the prepared masala paste and salt, and mix gently to coat the fish.
Return the fried fish to the pan, toss gently and serve hot.

name: Moringa curry leaf protein podi
creator: See source link
description: Dry chutney powder of crisp dried moringa and curry leaves with roasted peanuts, urad dal, chana dal, garlic, chillies, tamarind, sesame, flax seeds and coconut. Eat a spoon with rice and ghee or idli. Sun-drying time of the leaves not counted. Makes about 20 servings of 1 to 2 tsp (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Curry leaves
ingredients.amount: 3 to 4 handfuls dried (weight assumed, fresh-leaf values used)

ingredients.name: Dried red chilli
ingredients.amount: 5 dry red and 2 Kashmiri chillies (weight assumed)

steps: Sun-dry the moringa and curry leaves until crisp, or dry-roast them on low heat or microwave in short bursts.
Heat ghee in a heavy pan, add hing and cumin and let it crackle.
Add the dry red chillies and garlic and sauté gently until fragrant.
Add peanuts, urad dal, chana dal and tamarind and roast on low heat, stirring often, until evenly toasted and the dals are cooked.
Add salt, amchur, pepper and chilli powder and mix.
Add sesame, flax seeds and coconut at the end and roast gently until fragrant, since they burn quickly.
Mix in the dried moringa and curry leaves so everything is combined.
Cool completely, then grind into a slightly coarse powder and store.

name: Broccoli paneer mushroom stir fry
creator: See source link
description: Crunchy briefly steamed broccoli stir-fried with browned mushrooms, pan-fried paneer, garlic and onion in a soy, chilli flake and tapioca starch sauce. Garnished with sesame seeds and served with rice. 2 servings (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 1 to 2 tsp plus a little for the paneer (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Tapioca starch
ingredients.amount: 1 tbsp mixed with 5 tbsp water (weight assumed)

steps: Steam the broccoli florets for only 6 minutes, then put in ice-cold water to stop cooking and keep the crunch and colour.
Pan-fry the paneer cubes in a little oil on low heat until brown on each side. Set aside.
Cook the sliced mushrooms in a little oil, stirring, until nicely browned.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, chilli flakes and the tapioca starch paste mixed with water. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the broccoli, salt and pepper and mix.
Add the paneer at the end, mix well, garnish with sesame seeds and serve with rice.

name: High-protein black chana tofu soup
creator: See source link
description: Warming soup of boiled black chana, mixed vegetables and tofu simmered in the chana stock with freshly ground roasted spice powder and rassam powder, topped with onion, coriander, green chilli, black salt and lemon juice. 4 servings (servings and vegetable weights assumed).

ingredients.name: Boiled black chana
ingredients.amount: 1 cup dry black chana, soaked and boiled (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Broccoli
ingredients.amount: part of 4 to 5 cups mixed vegetables (weight assumed)

steps: Dry roast the curry leaves, coriander seeds, cumin, peppercorns, ajwain, hing, garlic and ginger until fragrant. Cool and grind into a fine powder.
Boil the black chana with cinnamon, bay leaf and black cardamom until soft. Keep the water.
Heat ghee in a pan and sauté the mixed vegetables with salt until slightly tender, covered to keep moisture.
Add the boiled chana, the ground masala and the rassam powder and cook together.
Add the reserved chana water, about 4 parts to 1 part chana, and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes.
Gently fold in the tofu cubes and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
Serve hot, topped with chopped onion, coriander, green chilli and black salt. Let it cool slightly before squeezing lemon juice over.

name: Creamy mushroom paneer
creator: See source link
description: Caramelised mushrooms with onion and garlic in a creamy sauce of soaked cashews, sesame seeds and red chillies blended with low-fat paneer. Serve with herbed rice. Serves 2. Soaking time of 20 to 30 minutes not counted in prep time.

ingredients.name: Red chilli
ingredients.amount: 2 red chillies, soaked, plus a little for garnish (weight assumed)

steps: Soak the cashews, sesame seeds and red chillies in water for 20 to 30 minutes. Keep the soaking water.
Heat butter in a pan and add the garlic and onion.
Add the thinly sliced mushrooms with salt and cook until they caramelise.
Blend the soaked cashews, sesame and chillies with the paneer, using some of the soaking water.
Pour the paste over the mushrooms and cook another 5 minutes, adding water to adjust the thickness.
Garnish with coriander and chopped red chilli and serve with herbed rice.

name: Chipotle tofu crumble rice bowl
creator: See source link
description: Bowl of herbed rice, sautéed vegetables and crispy cumin-soy tofu crumble on a bed of lettuce, topped with avocado, coriander and a creamy chipotle yogurt dressing. Makes 3 servings. Creator states about 460 to 500 kcal and 25 to 30 g protein per serving.

ingredients.name: Dried red chilli
ingredients.amount: 2 dry chipotle chillies, or dry red chilli (weight assumed)

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: dressing, veggies and rice, to taste (amount assumed)

ingredients.name: Cumin powder
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp in dressing and 1 tsp for tofu

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp each for rice, veggies and tofu (about 5 g each)

ingredients.name: Chilli flakes
ingredients.amount: 1 tsp for rice plus some for tofu (weight assumed)

steps: Blend the dried chillies, yogurt, salt, vinegar, cumin, garlic and ginger into a dressing and chill it.
Heat a little oil, add the cooked rice with mixed herbs and chilli flakes and toss until hot.
Sauté the zucchini, Brussels sprouts, carrot, bell pepper, corn and onion in oil with salt and pepper, covered, until slightly tender.
Heat oil with soy sauce in a pan, crumble in the tofu with cumin and chilli flakes and cook on low heat, stirring, until a little crispy.
Arrange chopped lettuce in a bowl and top with rice, vegetables and tofu crumble.
Add avocado and coriander and drizzle with the chipotle dressing.

name: Air-fried lauki rice rava fingers
creator: See source link
description: Crispy finger-shaped snack of grated lauki cooked with rice rava and spices into a dough, shaped into small sticks and air-fried until golden. Serve with mint chutney, hung curd dip or ketchup. 4 servings (servings assumed).

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: oil spray for the air fryer basket (amount assumed)

steps: Heat ghee in a wok on medium heat, add hing, cumin and sesame seeds and let them splutter.
Add the grated lauki and cook a few minutes until it softens and releases moisture.
Add the rice rava, chilli powder, turmeric, coriander powder, garam masala and salt.
Cook on low heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often, until the rava is cooked and the mixture comes together like dough. Add a little more rava if it is too wet.
Let the mixture cool completely.
Roll about a teaspoon of mixture into small finger-shaped sticks.
Spray the air fryer basket lightly with oil and arrange the sticks in one layer.
Air fry at 180 C for 12 to 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy. Start checking from 10 minutes.
Serve right away with mint chutney, hung curd dip or ketchup.
